content.text:
Same hyperparameters (`configs/baselines.yaml`), v2 grouped split:

| model | v1 (window split) | v2 (grouped by student) |
|---|---|---|
| majority | 0.21 | 0.21 |
| GBM | **0.81** | **0.74** |
| BiLSTM | 0.79 | 0.72 |

Both learned models lose ~7 points; the majority baseline is unchanged (as expected, it does not see students). The ranking GBM > BiLSTM holds.
